## Overview

Fix MoRIIO WRITE cancellation before the first submission, so an aborted producer can release a waiting decode request. Depends on #59058; related: #59382.

## Claims

- Serialize cancellation with one shared, irreversible submission gate across targets and layers. Pre-submit cancellation makes zero WRITE attempts and releases once; any possibly accepted attempt, including a submit exception, retains ownership.
- Preserve #61726's sessions, TP mapping, routing, writer counts and attention/Mamba paths. Cancellation remains homogeneous-TP only; #58962 stays separate.

## Validation

CPU on pinned main `fb61ac07` + #59058:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Focused | 55 passed |
| Related | 674 passed / 35 skipped / 5 failed; baseline 655 / 35 / same 5 |
| Same two-file oracle | Conflict-only port: 24 passed / 3 failed; candidate: 27 passed |
| Unchanged scheduler abort oracle | Dependency: 1 failed; candidate: 1 passed |
| Applicable hooks, including mypy 3.11 | Passed |

The five failures are unchanged CPU hybrid-cache configuration failures, retained as failures. Test additions were reduced from 791 to 525 lines; production code is unchanged from `a66e343f`.

<details>
<summary>Focused CPU reproduction</summary>

In a prepared CPU venv with cached OPT config, create `cpu_noclean.py` on `PYTHONPATH`:

```python
import pytest


def pytest_collection_modifyitems(items):
    for item in items:
        item.add_marker(pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup)
```

This disables accelerator cleanup only. Run from the PR checkout:

```bash
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 VLLM_HOST_IP=127.0.0.1 \
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p cpu_noclean \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_moriio_{write_abort,unmap,write_done_routing}.py
```

</details>

## Details

Flow: D allocates blocks → P aborts with WRITE queued → P worker sends `write_failed` and a release ACK if cancellation wins. A later target/layer failure cannot reset a transfer to zero-submit after an earlier attempt.

**Unverified:** GPU/serving, DMA fencing, safe reuse after partial submission or peer death, heterogeneous cancellation and transfer-ID reuse. `request_terminal != io_quiescent`; ambiguous submissions may remain held indefinitely. Newer main commits are not covered by this pinned replay.
